source.ncitLicenseNote: NCIt is published by NCI EVS as free, non-licence-restricted biomedical terminology. Prefer terms, codes, synonyms, neoplastic status, and hierarchy from Neoplasm Core with attribution.
source.icdoNote: ICD-O morphology codes included only when present as NCIm source=ICDO mappings for a Core concept (typically ICD-O-3 style morph/behaviour codes). Full ICD-O-4 morphology and topography tables are IARC/WHO copyright and are not bundled; see https://tumourclassification.iarc.who.int/icd-o-4/
source.genesisPolicy: Genesis Lab writes original educational framing. NCI definitions are stored as attributed sourceDefinition fields and are not claimed as Genesis Lab original prose.

licensingLimits: Full ICD-O-4 morphology and topography tables are not bundled (IARC/WHO copyright; wider reproduction requires permission).
ICD-O codes present are those linked via NCIm ICDO mappings to Neoplasm Core concepts (commonly ICD-O-3 style).
NCI cancer.gov page prose is not scraped or copied; only search links are provided.
Neoplasm Core is a curated core (~1.4k concepts), not a claim of every rare entity in full NCIt or every ICD-O code.
Site–histology pairs are not invented: hierarchy placements come only from Neoplasm Core hierarchy files.
completenessStatement: This catalogue mirrors NCI Thesaurus Neoplasm Core membership and hierarchy for the downloaded release. It is not a literal claim of completeness of all recognised tumours worldwide or of ICD-O-4.
